commitments.target: Targeting full year revenue of totally INR450 to INR500 crores between OSAT and PCB businesses for FY27.
commitments.quote: As far as OSAT and PCB is concerned, we already told from third quarter the revenue starts in both the business, and we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time, we are on the target.
commitments.speaker: N. Muthukumar

commitments.target: Plan to capex at about INR300 crores for OSAT and PCB respectively.
commitments.quote: Our current goal is to capex at about INR300 crores for OSAT and PCB, but as and when, as I said earlier, with the subsidies coming up, we'll be funding more, and as and when we have more customers, we have to do more.
commitments.speaker: N. Muthukumar

claims.claim: Total revenue stood at INR946 crores, reflecting 40% year-on-year growth driven largely by EMS.
claims.quote: Our total revenue stood at INR946 crores, reflecting an year-on-year growth of 40%, which is largely driven by EMS business.

claims.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR147.6 crores with an EBITDA margin of 15.6%.
claims.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR147.6 crores, translating into an EBITDA margin of 15.6% and 31% year-on-year growth.

claims.claim: The company has a robust order book of around INR9,000 crores.
claims.quote: We have a robust order book of around INR9,000 crores.

claims.claim: Standalone EMS business grew 53% from INR480 crores to INR639 crores.
claims.quote: As a stand-alone EMS business if you see, our growth is 53%, from INR480 crores of last year to this year of INR639 crores stand-alone EMS business.

claims.claim: Metering business sales was INR204 crores compared to INR231 crores last year, a minus 12% growth.
claims.quote: At the metering business, last year first quarter our sales was INR231 crores, and this year it is INR204 crores, which means a minus 12% growth.

claims.claim: Received government subsidy to the tune of INR170 crores in OSAT business till July 26.
claims.quote: We also received, happy to say that we also received the government subsidy to the tune of INR170 crores in OSAT business till July 26.

analyst_concerns.question: Pushed back on softer EBITDA margins despite strong inventory and working capital increases.
analyst_concerns.quote: And while operating performance has been pretty strong given the increase in inventories as well as working capital, EBITDA margins have been much softer.

analyst_concerns.question: Asked about management's thought process on divesting the underperforming smart metering business.
analyst_concerns.quote: Any views in terms of opportunities to divest this business in future? Some of the utilities are looking to buy out the metering businesses, so what would be your thought process on this side to release both the working capital and management bandwidth from the smart metering direct B2C portfolio that we have here?

analyst_concerns.question: Pressed for absolute figures on cash flow from operations, inventory, receivables, and payables.
analyst_concerns.quote: My first question is, if you could help us with the absolute figures of the cash flow from operations for this quarter, if it is available?

analyst_concerns.question: Questioned whether component shortages and price hikes would lead to gross margin compression over the next 9 months.
analyst_concerns.quote: So, do you expect in the coming 9 months we will see the gross margin compression because of that?
